techniques.name: Compiler/interpreter feedback loop
techniques.goal: Turn syntax/runtime failures into objective repair evidence
techniques.mechanism: Compile or execute generated code in sandbox, feed exact error plus relevant local context back for bounded repair.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer exact machine error over model self-critique; cap rounds.

techniques.name: Unit-test feedback loop
techniques.goal: Use executable behavioral oracle to guide code repair
techniques.mechanism: Run focused tests, feed failed assertions/traceback and expected behavior to repairer, rerun until pass or budget exhausted.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: After visible tests pass, run broader/hidden/regression checks.

techniques.name: Generate-many + execution rerank
techniques.goal: Increase functional success by sampling multiple candidate programs and selecting with execution
techniques.mechanism: Generate N variants, compile/test each, choose passing/highest-scoring candidate.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Adaptive N; stop on first candidate satisfying strong oracle.
avoid_when: Large repo edits where N branches are expensive

techniques.name: Learned execution verifier
techniques.goal: Rank code when tests are sparse or execution outputs need semantic interpretation
techniques.mechanism: Train/evaluate verifier on prompt, program and execution result, combine score with generator probability.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use deterministic tests first; learned verifier can triage/augment.

techniques.name: External-feedback self-repair
techniques.goal: Improve repair reliability over same-model introspection
techniques.mechanism: Provide compiler/test/static-analysis/human feedback rather than asking the model to inspect itself without evidence.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Failure registry should record repairability by error class.

techniques.name: Repair-vs-resample routing
techniques.goal: Choose whether to fix failed candidate or generate a fresh one
techniques.mechanism: Classify failure type and expected repair probability; repair local/simple errors, resample when design/logical path appears fundamentally wrong.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Learn from Agent OS historical error/repair outcomes.
risks: Classifier can anchor on bad candidate

techniques.name: Static linting as deterministic preflight
techniques.goal: Catch cheap style, syntax-adjacent and known bug patterns before model review
techniques.mechanism: Run fast linter/type/style rules and autofixes where safe before expensive model reviewer.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Order validators cheapest-to-most-expensive.
avoid_when: Generated domain where linter has no rules
risks: Autofix can alter semantics in rare cases

techniques.name: Type checking
techniques.goal: Detect incompatible interfaces/data assumptions before runtime
techniques.mechanism: Run static type checker/compiler type system; feed precise failures to repairer.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Schemas + generated typed bindings reduce model guessing.
avoid_when: Dynamic reflection makes type info weak

techniques.name: Static taint/security analysis
techniques.goal: Catch dangerous data flows deterministically
techniques.mechanism: Apply source→propagator→sink rules and vulnerability patterns to generated diffs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Mandatory independent gate for relevant code changes.

techniques.name: Property-based testing
techniques.goal: Explore many inputs from invariants rather than a handful of examples
techniques.mechanism: Generate structured inputs satisfying strategies/preconditions, check invariant, shrink failure to minimal counterexample and replay it.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: LLM can propose properties, but human/deterministic review validates them.
avoid_when: Behavior cannot be expressed as invariant

techniques.name: Metamorphic testing
techniques.goal: Test systems without known exact output oracle
techniques.mechanism: Define transformations whose outputs should remain invariant or change predictably; compare original/transformed cases.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Excellent for prompt/model regression: paraphrase, order, irrelevant-context, format transformations.

techniques.name: Mutation testing
techniques.goal: Measure whether tests actually detect plausible code defects
techniques.mechanism: Systematically mutate operators/conditions/constants; tests should fail for non-equivalent mutants.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use to evaluate AI-generated tests before trusting them as self-improvement oracle.
avoid_when: Large slow codebase without selective mutation

techniques.name: Coverage-guided fuzzing
techniques.goal: Discover crashes/security states beyond hand-written tests
techniques.mechanism: Instrument control flow, mutate inputs, retain cases reaching new coverage and minimize crashing inputs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Particularly valuable for browser bridge/importers/document parsers.
avoid_when: Pure model-output quality without executable harness

techniques.name: LLM-seeded fuzz corpus
techniques.goal: Give fuzzer semantically rich starting cases and grammar hints
techniques.mechanism: Use model to generate diverse valid/near-valid seeds, then let deterministic coverage-guided fuzzer mutate/explore.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Deduplicate/minimize seeds by coverage before campaign.

techniques.name: Differential testing
techniques.goal: Find defects when two independent implementations should agree
techniques.mechanism: Run same inputs through old/new, provider A/B, parser variants, model routes or optimized/reference implementation and compare invariant-relevant outputs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Foundation for champion/challenger migrations.
risks: Difference may not identify which is correct

techniques.name: Golden-master / snapshot testing
techniques.goal: Detect broad output changes cheaply
techniques.mechanism: Capture reviewed structured output/artifact snapshot and compare future runs, requiring explicit review of diffs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Normalize timestamps/order/random IDs before diff.
avoid_when: Output naturally varies or snapshot includes noisy fields

techniques.name: Hidden tests
techniques.goal: Reduce overfitting visible unit tests during automated repair
techniques.mechanism: Keep evaluator cases inaccessible to generator/repairer until final evaluation.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Separate repair feedback suite from protected regression suite.
avoid_when: Debugging where developer legitimately needs failing case
risks: Hidden failures are harder to debug

techniques.name: Adversarial test generation
techniques.goal: Search for inputs likely to break current implementation/model behavior
techniques.mechanism: Use model, fuzzing or optimizer to generate cases maximizing validator failure/disagreement, then human/deterministic validation promotes real failures.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Adversary cannot edit target's security gate or oracle.
avoid_when: Generated adversarial cases lack a valid oracle
risks: Test generator can exploit metric artifacts

techniques.name: Counterexample minimization
techniques.goal: Turn complex failure into smallest reproducible case
techniques.mechanism: Shrink failing generated/fuzz/metamorphic input while preserving failure predicate.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Store minimal regression fixture plus link to original evidence.
avoid_when: Failure depends on distributed timing/global state
risks: Shrink can accidentally alter underlying cause

techniques.name: Delta debugging / automated bisection
techniques.goal: Identify minimal change set that introduces failure
techniques.mechanism: Systematically remove input/change subsets or binary-search commits/config changes while re-running failure predicate.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Meta Engine should invoke before speculative root-cause model calls when predicate is deterministic.
risks: Interactions between multiple required changes complicate search

techniques.name: Fault localization before repair
techniques.goal: Limit model context/edit surface to likely causal regions
techniques.mechanism: Use stack traces, coverage, failing assertions, changed-file graph, static analysis and git history to rank relevant code before asking model to patch.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Compiler/test evidence drives selective context.

techniques.name: SMT/constraint solver verification
techniques.goal: Prove/check logical constraints beyond sampled tests
techniques.mechanism: Translate invariants/constraints into SAT/SMT formulas and ask solver for satisfiable models/counterexamples.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: LLM may draft model; deterministic solver provides answer; formalization itself reviewed/tested.
avoid_when: Informal requirements cannot be modeled reliably

techniques.name: Proof-assistant verification
techniques.goal: Require machine-checkable proof for critical formal claim
techniques.mechanism: Generate/search Lean/Coq/Isabelle proof terms checked by trusted kernel.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use selectively for security-critical invariants, not as blanket requirement.
avoid_when: Most ordinary business logic where proof cost dwarfs benefit

techniques.name: Neuro-symbolic proposal + formal checker
techniques.goal: Combine model creativity with exact symbolic correctness
techniques.mechanism: LLM proposes candidate program/proof/constraint solution; formal/executable checker accepts or supplies counterexample; search iterates.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: One of the strongest general patterns: creative proposer + hard verifier.

techniques.name: Evolutionary program search with automated evaluator
techniques.goal: Discover improvements beyond one-shot coding through iterative variation/selection
techniques.mechanism: Maintain candidate program population, sample high-performing/diverse parents, ask models for mutations, execute objective evaluator, retain strong/diverse offspring.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Meta Engine can use this only inside tightly sandboxed benchmarkable code regions.
avoid_when: Subjective software architecture with weak evaluator

techniques.name: Skeleton-constrained evolutionary search
techniques.goal: Focus AI search on the uncertain/high-leverage part of a known-good program
techniques.mechanism: Freeze boilerplate/invariants and evolve only a function/parameter/rule inside a validated skeleton.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Excellent simplification principle: don't ask model to recreate solved structure.

techniques.name: Diversity-preserving island search
techniques.goal: Avoid converging on one local optimum during large candidate search
techniques.mechanism: Maintain semi-isolated populations/islands with periodic reseeding/migration, favoring both fitness and diversity.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Future research technique, not ordinary Orchestrator pattern.
risks: Very high compute and population management

techniques.name: Performance profiling before optimization
techniques.goal: Spend optimization effort on measured bottleneck rather than intuition
techniques.mechanism: Instrument wall time, CPU, I/O, allocations, model/tool latency and call counts; rank hotspots before changing implementation.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: No performance improvement candidate should lack baseline profile when measurable.

techniques.name: Benchmark-guided code optimization
techniques.goal: Accept optimization only if representative benchmark improves without correctness regression
techniques.mechanism: Run reproducible benchmark + correctness suite on candidate change, including warm/cold and representative workload distributions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Store machine/environment/version so numbers remain interpretable.

techniques.name: Test-generation quality measured by mutation score
techniques.goal: Evaluate AI-generated tests by whether they detect plausible faults rather than whether they merely pass
techniques.mechanism: Generate tests, ensure baseline passes, run mutation testing and retain tests that kill meaningful mutants/cover new behavior.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Generated tests are candidates until they prove incremental defect-detection value.
avoid_when: Mutation operators do not model target defects well
risks: Optimizer can game mutation operator set
